collision_check: find <studio>/art -name prop-*.fbx checked; recorder/fipple/labium/reamer names all free; no renames
judgment_calls: Chose prop-labium-cutter (option 3) over reed-knife: fits recorder trade (labium/window cut)
Recorder finger holes are dark inset-quad marks, not boolean bores, to stay under 120 tris; open ends shown by inner bore lip ring
Recorder and reamer laid along X so z-min 0 rests naturally
Fipple block: 8-sided plug with flattened windway top
